review_conclusions: The dedicated CLI roles install resource admission before scientific imports. Preparation is capped at 2 CPU seconds; supervision keeps a 3-second default SIGXCPU soft limit while admitting a worker that independently installs its 55-second hard limit, then drops its own hard limit to 3 seconds.

The summed process CPU caps are 60 seconds. Before each PES geometry the worker conservatively charges 5 prior process-cap seconds and stops admitting at 55 combined seconds. The worker has the same absolute 120-second wall deadline and a two-second admission reserve.

Separate preparation/supervisor UUID tokens, immutable registration, RUN_ONCE and WORKER_ONCE files, parent PID/token validation and exclusive output creation prevent ordinary repeated invocation. There is no automatic resume or fallback output.

Popen assigns child ownership before later limit/log writes; all handled post-spawn errors enter the cleanup finally. SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers cover owned-child cleanup. Only the new child session is terminated and reaped, with a bounded SIGKILL fallback.

Initial calibration, follow-up calibration and diagnostic ledgers are durable before their corresponding energy evaluations. Every attempted geometry is logged before the PES call; zero draws remain in the fixed cohort, and partial data/failures remain on disk.

Current actual imported package/model paths, library hash, scientific package versions, environment and source files are checked. Protected design identities cannot be replaced by current-file inventory hashes.

Aggregate diagnostics require the fixed fresh membership; a resource stop, failed calibration, nonfinite energy, source change or incomplete cohort withholds a complete result. No physical rate or paper agreement is emitted.
scope: Read-only source, admission, ownership, resource, staged-history and imported-identity review. This is not root resource adoption or authorization to launch.
